content:
sasha: quick check — we need final copy for internal release notes and to lock cutover timing for RC-2026.2. proposing Tue 23:00 UTC -> Wed 02:00 UTC as the change window. okay with everyone?
kevin: double-checking migrations: the DB migration in the candidate is online but has a short backfill step that can spike writes. i'd prefer canary first, small traffic shift.
olivia: +1 to canary. also can we keep the announce short: what changed, rollback lane, and who to ping (ops ambassador). i'll draft snippet.
maria: timeline question — are we expecting any dependent infra deploys? if so we should sequence them before the public blast.
jamal: rollback criteria proposal: automatic rollback if error-rate > 1.5% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency increases by >120ms vs baseline for 5m. manual rollback if any data-loss indicator or migration failure.
sasha: thanks. jamal can you post that as a bullet in the RN draft? kevin can you confirm the migration backfill window?
kevin: backfill is ~15m on heavy traffic, but we can throttle it; i'll add a feature flag to gate it and default off for canary.
deploy-bot: scheduled_deploy: RC-2026.2 -> staging at 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z. canary plan: 0.5% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% with 10m pauses. (id: dpl-5832-rc2026)
olivia: draft internal RN snippet below — please edit inline. short, actionable.
olivia: ```
Internal release notes — RC-2026.2 (cutover window Tue 23:00 UTC)
- What: runtime and routing fixes; improved batching heuristics; DB migration for job metadata (backfill gated by feature flag)
- Impact: brief prefix warmup can cause p50+p95 token latency to shift by ~20ms during canary; no schema changes that break clients
- Rollback: automated rollback on error-rate >1.5% or p99 +120ms; manual rollback instructions pinned in the runbook (eng-releases > runbook/rc-2026)
- Who to ping: @kevin (migrations), @jamal (deploy lead), ops-ambassador oncall
```
maria: tiny nit: change "brief prefix warmup" -> "brief prefix/KV warmup" for accuracy.
jamal: added: evacuation lanes — if canary shows model-serving OOMs, shift traffic to fallback model variant (rv1-small) and abort rollout.
sasha: perfect. kevin, maria can we lock the quiet window notification? i want a 30m heads up before the canary start and a follow-up update at each traffic-step.
kevin: will do. adding deploybot cues and a calendar invite to the release channel.
deploy-bot: deploy_cue: will send 30m pre-notice and step-completion pings to #eng-releases.
jamal: final ask — pin the release notes snippet in the channel and mark the RN owner. i'll be on-call during the window.
olivia: pinning now. owner: jamal. i'll post the short audience-facing blurb for comms team after cutover is green. :+1:
sasha: thanks all. if no objections by EOD UTC i'll finalize and move to staging canary tomorrow.
kevin: no objections from me.
maria: good from infra side.
jamal: all set from deploy.
deploy-bot: canary_started: RC-2026.2 -> prod canary 0.5% at 2026-03-22T23:00:00Z (dpl-5832-rc2026).
